Verbum Dei Jesuit High School seeks a creative, organized Marketing and Communications Coordinator to share the school’s story, strengthen its visibility, and engage students, families, alumni, donors, corporate partners, and prospective families.

Reporting to the Vice President of Mission Advancement, the Coordinator maintains the school’s brand and coordinates marketing and communications across digital and print platforms. This role works closely with Mission Advancement, Admissions, Athletics, and the Corporate Work Study Program to deliver timely, engaging communications that reflect Verbum Dei’s Catholic, Jesuit mission.

* Maintain consistent branding and design print and digital materials, including brochures, invitations, presentations, signage, and advertisements.

* Write, edit, and coordinate newsletters, email campaigns, press releases, announcements, and other school communications; support annual reports, impact reports, and institutional publications.
* Maintain an editorial calendar, gather content across departments, and coordinate publication schedules to ensure accuracy and timely delivery.
* Manage Mailchimp or comparable email platforms, including formatting, audience segmentation, distribution, and performance tracking.
* Update website content and digital displays, coordinate photography and videography, maintain organized digital assets, and support media relations.
* Develop campaigns, marketing materials, and impact stories supporting fundraising, student recruitment, and corporate partnerships.
* Promote school events, coordinate related media coverage and vendors, track marketing performance, and perform other related duties as assigned.

This full-time, 12-month position is based on campus. Occasional evening and weekend hours are required for school events, athletics, fundraising, and community engagement. Some off-campus work may be required for corporate partner visits, media coverage, and special events.

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and portfolio or relevant work samples demonstrating skills in writing, graphic design, photography, video production, and social media content creation.

sandrade@verbjesuit.org

**About Radiant**
-----------------

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running. Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028.

**About the Role**
------------------

Radiant is looking for an Indirect Procurement Associate to support sourcing and procurement of indirect goods and services — Facilities, IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, and R&D collaborations. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong technical instincts who wants to build skills in supplier evaluation, negotiation, and contract support. You'll work alongside Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Production, and will be paired with more senior procurement staff to develop your commercial and negotiation skill set.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Support sourcing efforts for indirect categories (IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, R&D collaborations) by gathering technical requirements and evaluating supplier capability against Radiant's engineering needs.
* Assist with drafting and reviewing SOWs, NDAs, and PO terms; help prepare negotiation positions for MSAs and licensing agreements under guidance from senior staff.
* Help manage facilities/MRO procurement tasks — coordinating with vendors on maintenance, repairs, equipment, and small lab build-out needs.
* Track purchase orders through the procure-to-pay cycle, flagging delays or technical mismatches early.
* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for select, lower-complexity suppliers, escalating high-stakes commercial matters to senior procurement staff.
* Contribute technical judgment to cost and quality trade-off discussions.
* Help identify supply chain risks from an engineering/technical perspective (e.g., part obsolescence, service quality issues).
* Support process documentation and improvement efforts.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related engineering field) strongly preferred, Supply Chain or similar degrees considered
* 1–3 years of relevant experience; prior procurement/sourcing experience is a plus but not required.
* Strong technical/mechanical aptitude and genuine interest in the commercial side of engineering (supplier selection, cost trade-offs, contracts).
* Good analytical and organizational skills; comfortable learning negotiation and contract fundamentals on the job.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable with ERP/MRP systems and standard office software (or willing to learn quickly).
* Occasional travel to supplier locations (up to 20%).

**Desired Qualifications**

* Exposure to Facilities, MRO, IT, or Professional Services sourcing.
* Coursework or interest in quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100).
* Interest in the energy/nuclear sector.

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
* Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.
* Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.
* One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.
* Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.
* Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.
* Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.
* 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.
* Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear.
* Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.
* Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.
* Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.
* Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.
